comparisonPlan.hypothesis: 숙소 비교를 위한 상세 조회 유입이 공연 일정 공개 후 증가했다가 감소하는 상황
comparisonPlan.reasonForPeak: Single app at 6000 planned RPS showed p95 827ms and approximately 5540 completed RPS in exploratory calibration; use a peak within the separate load-generator capacity
comparisonPlan.routing: Per-process isolated DNS maps api.airbob.cloud only to dynamically resolved owned ALB IPv4; verified HTTPS connects directly; host DNS and hosts files unchanged.
arms: CPU target tracking 50%, warmup180s, min1 max4
candidate selected after startup/capacity and CPU50 evidence; freeze before its run
caveats: read request workload, not a simulated authenticated user session
single AZ app group; no availability-zone failure claim
4000 VU cap; scheduled request shortfalls and dropped iterations are reported separately from HTTP failures
one baseline instance protected from scale-in to preserve original runtime; unhealthy replacement remains enabled
comparisonPlan.baselineExplanation: The fixed-one arm ends after the same low/rise/peak prefix; only autoscaling arms continue the fall and recovery needed to observe scale-in.
comparisonPlan.metricCollection: Same 120 latency bucket submetrics; phase-level counts and failure/slow rates; empty thresholds; summary percentiles computed after the run. Completed counts per bucket come from latency Trend count.
comparisonPlan.betweenArms: Before enabling the first scaling policy after fixed-one, wait until at least three recent one-minute CPU averages are below 30% and the latest point is fresh. Keep the five-minute low stage in each arm.

candidate.label: cpu-50-slow-start-120
candidate.changedFactor: ALB slow_start.duration_seconds:0 to120; same CPU target-tracking policy
candidate.reason: Each newly healthy app reached ~99% CPU just after first traffic; server waiting spikes while DNS/TLS fine, pool pending0, shared Redis CPU~19%. Test gradual traffic ramp without claiming exact JIT/client-initialization cause.
candidate.activation: After CPU50 arm completes and one healthy baseline remains.
